status_reason: 0 WY event(s) in the 2026-11-03 extract; the state's permittees do not file through NeT. Wyoming permittees report SSOs to WDEQ by phone and written notice.

status_reason: 'Reporting of the SSO should occur verbally within 24 hours of becoming aware of the event' and in writing 'Within a five day period after the event' (hand written or electronic).
